title: Chromatographic Profile of Aqueous Extract by HPLC
author: Luis Wiliunfo LWTT Torres Tapia
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wy9ffz6
materials: Movil phase consist: - Movil phase A contaned ultrapure type 1 water ( Simplicity® Water Purification System, Millipore) adjusted to pH 2.5 with trifluoroacetic acid (TFA). - Movil phase B contained acetonitrile (ACN). Each movil phase was filtered through 0.2 μm filter and finally was degassered during 30 min. in ultrasonic equipment.

- Profile was carried out on an Agilent Series 1290 Infinity HPLC System with vacuum degasser, quaternary pump, autosampler, thermostated column compartment and photodiode array detector (DAD). - Data analysis was performed with Agilent HPLC EZChrom software.

steps.title: Prepare sample for HPLC
steps.instruction: Add 10% methanol (v/v) to each aqueous extract to improve solubility, then filter the mixture through a 0.2 µm filter disc.

steps.title: Install column and set temperature
steps.instruction: Mount a Grace Alltima C18 column (4.6 mm × 250 mm, 5 µm particle size) on the HPLC system and set the column oven to 35 °C.

steps.title: Program gradient elution
steps.instruction: Program the HPLC gradient as follows: 0–3 min 5 % B; 3–43 min linear increase to 30 % B; 43–73 min linear increase to 85 % B; 73–75 min return to 5 % B.

steps.title: Set flow rate
steps.instruction: Set the mobile phase flow rate to 1 mL/min.

steps.title: Configure DAD detection
steps.instruction: Set the diode‑array detector to monitor at 254 nm and 350 nm.
